message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features a large illustration of three cartoon-style figures sitting on a green surface. In the center, a man with black hair and a white collared shirt sits cross-legged, holding a rectangular object and looking down with a squinted expression. To his left, a woman with black hair and glasses leans forward, writing on a piece of paper with a pen. An open book and a calculator lie on the floor in front of her. To the right, another woman wearing a headscarf and glasses points toward the central man. All three figures are drawn with thick black outlines and minimal shading.

A large yellow decorative shape at the bottom contains the black bold text "UTAK-ATIK DATA STATISTIK," with smaller text below it mentioning "Badan Pusat Statistik" and "Presiden Prabowo." The top of the cover features the large white word "TEMPO" against a green background, with smaller headlines "Nasib Sudewo Setelah Pati Membara H.28" and "Petinggi di Balik Kasus Penganiayaan Anggota Densus H.76" above it. A barcode and QR code are located in the bottom right corner.
